correctness.rationale: Using finite Esakia duality, all p-morphisms from P_n to P_m split into exactly m constant-to-maximal maps and m!S(n,m) root-fixing leaf-surjective maps. The induced homomorphism images have ranks 2 and 2^m+1 respectively. All quotient p-morphisms from P_m have either a singleton codomain or star codomain with leaf partition fibers, hence Bell-graded subalgebras. At n=m only leaf permutations and constant maps remain; precisely identity and constants are idempotent. Direct exhaustive checking included 82174 p-morphism function tables, 32906 candidate subalgebras, 81210 direct algebra maps across bounded sizes; see VERIFICATION.md. No finite check is presented as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The explicitly inspected Bumpus--Kocsis finite witness is exactly the Boolean-plus-one-top family, but their Theorem 3.8 computes a satisfiability-gap bound, not arbitrary homomorphisms or the subalgebra/retract rank census. Esakia-duality sources prove the general mechanism, while Adams deals with maximal subalgebras. Searches against published-finding corpus and the accessible current/prior cumulative ledger reveal no same-family joint classification. The implicit/conventional nature of star p-morphisms and unavailable Adams full text remain genuine originality risks.
residual_risks: 1986 Adams maximal-subalgebra article was not inspected in full, and a specialized consequence may already be documented.
The rooted-star p-morphism argument uses standard duality; an unindexed algebraic or semigroup-theoretic derivation could give the complete counts implicitly.
No independent expert originality determination has been performed.

value.rationale: The full family is an established extremal satisfiability-gap witness. An exact classification of all homomorphisms between its members, its entire partition-lattice subalgebra order, and its striking collapse to only two embedded retract subalgebras resolves natural but distinct structural invariants; results hold for all positive dimensions and give meaningful sharp cutoffs, not a single numerical curiosity. Existing witness paper asks satisfiability rather than these invariants.
